meta.link_format: https://www.amazon.com/dp/{asin}/?tag={tags_by_kind[page_kind]} (2026-10-08; amzn.to short links in `short` are the pre-split fallback)
meta.fit_semantics: Weights are adult lb; null = open. Types in contain_types need the breed's whole range inside [wmin,wmax] and skip multi_size_breeds; all other types need the breed's midpoint inside [wmin,wmax]. Non-breed pages (no weight) pass. life_stage 'adult' never goes on checklist pages (all are puppy checklists). coat keys come from breed_traits.json category via coat_map; 'any' disables the check. exclude_slugs removes pages outright.
meta.text_normalization: html.unescape(text + ' ' + faq_text) before matching; anchors/excludes are case-insensitive regex. samoyed-grooming-guide: pilot link text stripped before matching (see existing_links).
meta.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, Wooffy earns from qualifying purchases.
meta.disclosure_rule: Must appear on every page that carries a link, before the first link.
meta.extra_slug_rule: An extra slug is kept only if one of the entry's anchors matches it and it is not in exclude_slugs. exclude_if is written for breed pages; hits on a hand-read extra are reviewed by hand, not auto-dropped.

samoyed-grooming-guide.note: Repo breed-data/samoyed-grooming-guide.json (== sam_backup.json) still carries the pilot Big G link plus a disclosure; pages.json was extracted from it. Remove or reuse that link before placing, never add a second.

entries.caveat: Use light strokes; slicker pins can scratch skin if pressed hard.
entries.notes: Medium size; toy breeds (<10 lb) excluded via wmin. Yorkie page asks for a small slicker (excluded). Rake-first pages (pembroke-welsh-corgi-G, siberian-husky-G, labrador-retriever-G, polish-lowland-sheepdog-$, shiba-inu-$): link the undercoat rake there, not this brush.
